honest.app.configureHostResolver: the engine resolves hosts as the desktop's browser does
honest.app.disableDomainBlockingFor3DAPIs: the engine's policy, not the app's
honest.app.disableHardwareAcceleration: the engine decides for every page
honest.app.enableSandbox: pages are sandboxed unless they ask for Node
honest.app.isEmojiPanelSupported: false on Linux, as in Electron
honest.app.isHardwareAccelerationEnabled: the engine draws with the GPU
honest.autoUpdater.quitAndInstall: Electron has no autoUpdater on Linux
honest.BaseWindow.isResizable: the desktop can always size a window
honest.BaseWindow.setBounds: the desktop places and sizes windows
honest.BaseWindow.setContentBounds: the desktop places and sizes windows
honest.BaseWindow.setIcon: the desktop names windows by the app's icon
honest.BaseWindow.setProgressBar: the shell shows no progress yet
honest.BaseWindow.setTitleBarOverlay: the shell draws the title bar
honest.crashReporter.getLastCrashReport: the host sends no crash reports
honest.crashReporter.getUploadedReports: the host sends no crash reports
honest.globalShortcut.isRegistered: register refuses every shortcut, so none is
honest.WebContents.closeDevTools: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.getBackgroundThrottling: the engine throttles hidden pages as the browser does
honest.WebContents.isDevToolsFocused: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.isDevToolsOpened: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.openDevTools: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContents.setBackgroundThrottling: the engine throttles hidden pages as the browser does
honest.WebContents.toggleDevTools: the desktop has no devtools for apps
honest.WebContentsView.removeChildView: a view never holds views here: addChildView refuses

lies.BaseWindow.flashFrame: does nothing, where it should ask for the user's attention
lies.BaseWindow.getMediaSourceId: always empty, so the app can't name its own window to desktopCapturer
lies.BaseWindow.isEnabled: always true, and setEnabled does nothing, so a modal's parent still takes input
lies.BaseWindow.isFullScreen: the desktop doesn't tell the host a window's state
lies.BaseWindow.isMaximized: the desktop doesn't tell the host a window's state
lies.BaseWindow.isMinimized: the desktop doesn't tell the host a window's state
lies.BaseWindow.isModal: always false: the host doesn't pass modal or parent on
lies.BaseWindow.isNormal: follows from the state the host doesn't know
lies.BaseWindow.maximize: does nothing: the engine has no request for it
lies.BaseWindow.minimize: does nothing: the engine has no request for it
lies.BaseWindow.restore: does nothing: the engine has no request for it
lies.BaseWindow.setFullScreen: does nothing: the engine has no request for it
lies.BaseWindow.setIgnoreMouseEvents: does nothing, so a click-through overlay takes the clicks
lies.BaseWindow.unmaximize: does nothing: the engine has no request for it
lies.BrowserWindow.getFocusedWindow: always null, so chat apps think nobody is looking and notify or badge anyway
lies.NavigationHistory.canGoBack: a one-entry history: the engine doesn't report the page's history
lies.powerMonitor.getSystemIdleTime: always 0, so apps such as Slack never see the user away
lies.ServiceWorkers.getAllRunning: always none, though the engine runs the app's service workers
lies.systemPreferences.getAccentColor: empty, where Linux Electron gives the desktop's accent
lies.WebContents.getProcessId: always 0: the engine doesn't report the renderer
lies.WebContents.getUserAgent: empty, where the session's agent applies
lies.WebContents.isCrashed: always false, even after the page's renderer is gone
lies.WebContents.isLoading: always false: the engine doesn't report loading
lies.WebContents.setAudioMuted: does nothing: the engine has no mute for a page
lies.WebContents.setIgnoreMenuShortcuts: ignored, so the menu bar's shortcuts still fire
lies.WebContents.setUserAgent: does nothing: the engine sets agents per session
lies.WebContents.setWebRTCIPHandlingPolicy: ignored, so the page's WebRTC may use addresses the app asked it not to
lies.WebContents.setWindowOpenHandler: ignored: the engine opens the page's new windows itself, so the app never sees them
